258607.rationale: Pre-tournament odds: Aus ~1.65, Ind 4.5, Eng 5.5, SA 10-11. As of Jun 24, Australia (4-0, NRR +4.7) and hosts England (4-0) have qualified for the semis. India/SA/Bangladesh are fighting for Group A's second spot and WI are likely Group B runners-up. Likely semis: Aus v WI and Eng v India/SA. Final at Lord's Jul 5.
258607.next_info: Jun 25 Ind v Ban; Jun 27 Eng v NZ, WI v Ire; Jun 28 Aus v Ind, SA v Ban; semis ~Jul 1-3; final Jul 5. Re-weight after the semi-final line-up is fixed.

799550.rationale: The award usually goes to a player from the champion side, sometimes the runner-up. Wyatt-Hodge is England's top scorer (105*, 65; about 190 runs). Mandhana led the run charts (159 after 3 games), with Charani top wicket-taker (10). Australia's contributions are spread across many players (Perry was PoM v Pak), so no single Australian dominates.
799550.next_info: Updated stats leaderboards after the group stage (Jun 28) and the semis. Shift mass toward finalists' top performers. Check Sciver-Brunt fitness (Dean was stand-in captain Jun 24).

562262.rationale: India are the reigning T20 world champions (beat England in the 2026 WC semi) but field a new-look side under Shreyas Iyer, without SKY, Hardik or Bumrah, and Varun Chakravarthy is injured. England (Brook captain; Buttler, Salt, Archer, Rashid) are at home. Close to a coin flip with a slight India edge; a drawn series from rain is a small residual.
562262.next_info: T20Is Jul 1 (Chester-le-Street), Jul 4 (Old Trafford), Jul 7 (Trent Bridge), Jul 9 (Bristol), Jul 11 (Southampton). India v Ireland Jun 26/28 shows India's form.

131869.rationale: Three T20Is in Harare on Jul 23, 25 and 26. The squad isn't named yet but is likely the Iyer-led T20I group. The WC-winning top three were Abhishek, Samson and Kishan, and 15-year-old IPL Orange Cap holder Sooryavanshi is pushing to open. On flat Harare pitches the openers are favoured.
131869.next_info: India v Ireland XIs (Jun 26/28) and England T20Is (Jul 1-11) will show the opening pair. Zimbabwe squad announcement around mid-July. Match 1 is Jul 23.

179451.rationale: The 1st Test is Jul 25-29 at the Brian Lara Cricket Academy, Tarouba (its first Test). WI's squad v SL has a pace core of Seales, Shamar and Alzarri Joseph, Roach and Phillip, with spin from Warrican (VC) and Chase. Seales is the most reliable wicket-taker. Shamar Joseph is a strike bowler (PoS in the recent SL T20Is).
179451.next_info: WI v SL Tests Jun 25-29 and Jul 3-7 in Antigua (form and fitness of the Josephs). WI squad for Pakistan around mid-July. Day 1-3 is Jul 25-27.

920782.rationale: The 2nd Test is Aug 2-6 at Queen's Park Oval (some listings say Tarouba). Pakistan are in poor form (lost 0-2 in Bangladesh in May 2026); WI have home advantage and a fit pace attack. Rain in Trinidad's wet season makes a draw plausible, but the question's Aug 5 date hints at a day-4 result.
920782.next_info: Pakistan squad and captaincy for the WI tour (after the Bangladesh whitewash). WI v SL results (Jun 25 - Jul 7). 1st Test result Jul 25-29.

988210.rationale: McCullum was retained in March 2026 (contract to the 2027 WC), but England lost 6 of 8 Tests and the NZ series decider at Trent Bridge (Jun 25-29) is seen as 'last chance saloon'. Media-mooted successors include Kirsten, Trott (left the Afghanistan job and wants England), Flintoff (just named Sydney Thunder coach, which lowers his chances), Sangakkara, Morgan, Batty and Langer. Trescothick and Collingwood are internal, but interim appointments don't count.
988210.next_info: Result of the 3rd Test v NZ (Jun 25-29) and any ECB announcement on McCullum, possibly early July. Watch for an interim coach for the India white-ball series (Jul 1-19) and an appointment before the Pakistan Tests (Aug).

356699.rationale: Tests are Aug 13-17 in Darwin (Marrara) and Aug 22-26 in Mackay. Shanto is in top form (101 and 87 v Pak, 4 tons in 9 innings). Mushfiqur made 137 (PoS) and Litton 126 v Pak in May 2026, and Mominul made 91 and 56. The Aug 14 close date hints at a day-1/2 century in Darwin with Bangladesh batting first.
356699.next_info: Bangladesh Test squad for Australia (late July/Aug). 1st Test Aug 13-14.

971366.rationale: England's 3rd-Test XI v NZ (Jun 25) has a pace attack of Atkinson, Archer and Tongue, with Bashir as spinner and Stokes. Atkinson took 7 wickets at Lord's and has an elite home record. Robinson (knee), Fisher, Baker and Carse (injured) are alternatives. Rotation is likely by September.
971366.next_info: England squads for the Pakistan Tests (Aug). Workload rotation and injuries in Tests 1-2. The 3rd Test is around Sep 4-9.

540490.rationale: The 2027 WC (Oct 4 - Nov 21, SA/Zim/Nam) is widely framed as Rohit's (40 by then) and Kohli's swansong. Rohit is under the most pressure to state his plans. Kohli has talked about wanting to play 2027 without calling it his last. Jadeja is the next oldest ODI regular.
540490.next_info: Interviews and events Sep 1-20, 2026. India's ODI schedule (England ODIs Jul 14-19; NZ tour Oct 22 - Dec 1).
